attBesluta.text: Heavy Duty.....what a great addition to my boat trailer. Easy to install, works very well with the strap rather than the rope type and it looks great! Very adaptable to any application or position. Highly recommended!

Excellent quality, comfortable handle, easily got my 1500kg boat from being on tyres back onto the trailer, quick delivery, extremely happy. Only downside was it only has 2 holes drilled centrally, if more holes offered I wouldn't have had to drill to adapt. Overall I easily recommend.

Bollards were perfect for our application. Water wellhead was previously installed under a section of our driveway. When upgrading the pump to a submersible the wellhead was extended above the driveway surface so we installed 4 bollards around the wellhead. The wellhead is protected!
Came in nicely packaged and I like them but the concrete bolts were weak and broke in the concrete. Use your own to save this problem. I would still buy them but use your own bolts.

We have to assemble and disassemble this barre before and after every ballet class, which is pretty straightforward. When it is all put together it is pretty sturdy, though I recommend either attaching it to another barre set or weighing down the feet with sandbags for extra stability. It is of a very good quality, shipped quickly and has been working well for us so far.

Hochwertige Aluminiumprofile. Wertige Anmutung. Massivholzstangen. Angenehm in der Hand. 1,80 m Breite und T-förmige Füsse ermöglichen gute Bewegungsfreiheit. Ausreichend robust für Balllettraining. Stabile Kunsstoffverbindungsstücke. Federleicht. Passt nach dem Training an die Wand. Erstklassiges Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.
Easy to assemble. Lacks a bit of stability but with weights added to the bases it will stay put.

Great Cart and Lots of Storage! I’m really happy with this cart! It has a great amount of storage space, and I especially like the large basket and the extra lower basket. The wheels roll smoothly, and the cart feels sturdy and useful for carrying a lot of items. I’m especially excited to take it with me on walks out in public and use it when going to stores in the spring. I think it will be very convenient for carrying my things while I’m out. Overall, I’m very pleased with it and would recommend it to anyone looking for a spacious and useful cart
